sources.title: SBI VISA Crypto Card current product and reward terms
claims: The current product page says the card requires a VCTRADE crypto account and lets the cardholder choose one crypto asset per card from BTC, ETH or XRP.
The current page says standard card shopping earns one point worth JPY 1 per JPY 200 spent and Gold earns two points worth JPY 2 per JPY 200 spent.
The page says points for the monthly period from the 6th through the 5th are credited around the 17th and automatically exchanged into crypto by month-end without an exchange fee.
The conversion quantity is calculated using SBI VC Trade's displayed crypto sales price at 06:59:59 on the day before the exchange; XRP units are truncated to seven decimal places.
The page says the VCTRADE account holder name must match the cardholder and the account/card must remain active at conversion; otherwise the points are not exchanged and expire at month-end.
A new campaign is displayed for applications from 2026-09-01 through 2026-10-31, with card issuance by 2026-11-30, eligible spending through 2026-12-05 and reward delivery by the end of 2027-02.
The displayed campaign offers a JPY 500-equivalent crypto joining benefit per customer, standard-card spending rewards up to JPY 2,000 equivalent and Gold spending rewards up to JPY 4,000 equivalent.

The page specifies standard-card spending thresholds of JPY 100,000 for JPY 1,000 equivalent and JPY 200,000 for JPY 2,000 total; Gold thresholds are JPY 150,000 for JPY 2,000 and JPY 300,000 for JPY 4,000 total.
For campaign rewards when multiple cards are held, the page specifies priority Gold before Standard and BTC before ETH before XRP.
The page also describes a credit-card mutual-fund accumulation route through SBI Securities where a selected crypto asset can be earned.
limitations: The page does not disclose cardholder count, XRP selection share, aggregate reward points, XRP reward units, XRP inventory or monthly crypto conversion totals.
The reference price is SBI VC Trade's displayed sales price; it is not an exchange execution record and does not prove a contemporaneous spot-market purchase.
The page does not disclose whether crypto rewards are sourced from spot purchases, OTC, existing exchange inventory or internal transfers.
The campaign reward delivery date is future at capture; realized reward credits cannot yet be observed.
The page contains multiple program sections; campaign and base monthly rewards must be kept separate.
